# Braze investor relations — Leadership and Board of Directors

Captured 2026-09-02 from `https://investors.braze.com/governance/leadership/default.aspx`
and `https://investors.braze.com/governance/board-of-directors/default.aspx`.

Fetched through a browser: the host returns HTTP 403 to a plain command-line request, so
this is a transcription of the rendered page rather than a saved response body. The
leadership roster below is taken verbatim from the `alt` attributes of the headshot
images, which is where the site carries each person's name and title as text.

**Grade: `claimed`.** This is a company-published page. Where it agrees with the proxy it
is corroboration; where it differs it is *newer*, not more authoritative — see
`docs/CONFLICTS.md` C-11.

---

## Leadership, as published 2026-09-02

| Name | Title as published |
|---|---|
| Bill Magnuson | Chairman, Chief Executive Officer, President, and Cofounder |
| Jon Hyman | Cofounder and Chief Technology Officer |
| Ed McDonnell | Chief Revenue Officer |
| Astha Malik | Chief Business Officer |
| Pankaj Malik | Chief Financial Officer and Chief Accounting Officer |
| Priyanka Singh | Chief People Officer |
| Nick Rockwell | Chief Information Officer |
| Chris Lal | General Counsel and Corporate Secretary |
| Brian Wheeler | SVP of Engineering |
| Pearce Dolan | Chief Product Officer |

Ten people. The DEF 14A filed 2026-05-18 lists **six** executive officers as of
2026-05-04. The two lists are not the same measurement — "executive officer" is an SEC
term of art, "Leadership" is a marketing page — and they are four months apart. Both
differences matter and neither supersedes the other. Recorded as C-11.

## What this page does not say

It gives no tenure for any director but Magnuson, no independence determination, no
committee membership, and no ages. All of those are in the DEF 14A and are cited from
there, because a proxy statement is filed under legal penalty and a web page is not.
